description: Files the English-only fork does not ship: non-English dashboard and CLI catalogs, docs/i18n mirrors and the translation ratchet baseline (docs/ops/FORK_IDENTITY.md). The guard only judges feature PRs: the writer branches below and translation-only PRs stay exempt, so it does not enforce English-only by itself. The compact error-boundary catalogs (src/i18n/global-error-messages) and the route-handler catalog (src/i18n/route-handler-messages.json) are companions: they are regenerated from en.json, and a feature PR that edits en.json publicSystem.globalError or a ROUTE_HANDLER_MESSAGE_KEYS string must still be able to regenerate them.

categories.why: The fork ships English only (docs/ops/FORK_IDENTITY.md), so a feature PR that adds a non-English UI catalog fails here. A feature PR edits src/i18n/messages/en.json only.
